mutations.from:
Retry(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "Aborted"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "Retried"]
    /\ observations' = [observations EXCEPT ![c] = Append(@, locked)]
mutations.to:
Retry(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "Aborted"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "Retried"]
    /\ observations' = [observations EXCEPT ![c] = Append(@, FALSE)]
